title: Dimensional Showdown
next_chapter_hook: When blood seeped from Chen Ji's chest, the Tianji Record in his embrace finally radiated its complete brilliance—yet Ling Yuan's fangs had already quietly bitten toward his most fatal weakness.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the coordinates, the Tianji Record violently trembled as if sensing the call of something of the same origin. Yet what awaited him was not fortune, but an overwhelming killing intent. 'Chen Ji, I've been waiting for you for a long time.' Ling Yuan's voice came from all directions, as this former Tianqing Sect Elder's phantom slowly coalesced in the void, every pore exuding suffocating pressure. 'You think the Tianji Record chose you? It merely used you as a chess piece, sending you into this final game.' Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, only a cold glint flickering in the depths of his pupils—indeed, from the moment he stepped into these coordinates, everything had been within Ling Yuan's calculations.

Just then, the sky was suddenly torn apart by a chasm stretching thousands of feet, with purple-black dimensional power gushing out like a tide. Countless guardians in silver armor poured out from the rift, their auras uniform, as if controlled by a single will. 'It begins.' Chen Ji murmured, the Tianji Record rapidly turning in his palm, displaying countless flickering threads of karma—the number of guardians far exceeded expectations, the fate of the Three Realms balanced on the brink of complete collapse. In the distant battlefield, the allied forces of the Three Great Sects were gathering, but against these invaders from beyond dimensions, they seemed so insignificant.

On the Tianqing Sect flagship, Su Qingyao wore sharp battle armor, her sword-like brows tightly locked. Her gaze pierced through layers of clouds, firmly fixed on Chen Ji—this man had once again pushed himself into a death trap. 'Chen Ji, what are you plotting?' she murmured softly, her knuckles white from gripping. As an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she should have been commanding from the rear, yet she couldn't leave, because she knew this game might be beyond even Chen Ji's control. On the Demon Path Holy Sect's flying ship, Ye Qing was shrouded in swirling demonic mist, those妖异的 purple pupils flickering with complex emotions—the prophecy Chen Ji had shown her was unfolding scene by scene.

dialogue.content: 'All disciples, form the Xuanwu Battle Formation!' Su Qingyao's voice was cold and firm, piercing through the chaos of battle. Yet her gaze never left Chen Ji, watching as the man she once considered waste step by step walked toward the most dangerous front line. Her heart clenched—she didn't know when it had happened, but that man's back had become the sight she least wanted to see.

'The Dimensional Guardians are thirty percent more than I anticipated.' Ye Qing silently appeared at Chen Ji's side, demonic mist forming a pair of illusory wings behind her, 'Their vanguard has already locked onto you—the intent is clear: the Tianji Record.' She paused, lowering her voice further, 'Intelligence from Holy Sect agents suggests there's some kind of agreement between Ling Yuan and the Guardians. Chen Ji, this war might have been a game within a game from the very beginning.'

choice.prompt: The Dimensional Guardians' vanguard has locked onto your position, Ling Yuan's lethal trap is imminent, and the fate of the Three Realms alliance hangs by a thread—how will you respond to this decisive moment?

choices.description: Attack in place of defense, leading the Three Realms' elite forces to strike at the enemy leader's lair before the Guardians complete their formation
choices.visible_cost: Allied casualties may exceed fifty percent
choices.visible_reward: Greatly deter the enemy, weakening the Guardians' overall combat power
choices.risk_hint: If defeated, the Three Realms will completely lose their ability to counterattack

dialogue.content: 'You're going into battle personally?' Su Qingyao grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve, her fingertips trembling slightly, 'Do you know what that means? The Guardian Leader's power is enough to crush any sect master!' Her voice carried suppressed anger, yet her eye sockets were unconsciously reddening.

text.content: Chen Ji gently brushed away her hand, a faint smile curving his lips: 'Senior Sister Su, rest assured, I never fight battles I aren't confident about.' His gaze越过她，落在那漫天飞舞的守护者身上，'Besides, someone is more anxious than me.' Before the words even finished, Ling Yuan's figure actually appeared directly within the Guardian army—this old fox could finally no longer hide.

choices.description: Attempt to dialogue with the Guardian Leader during intense combat, probing the true purpose of the dimensional invasion, seeking the possibility of winning without fighting
choices.visible_cost: Give the enemy breathing room, possibly miss the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence, or divide the Guardians internally
choices.risk_hint: The Guardians may not be willing to negotiate, possibly seen as weakness
choices.process_label: 你选择以三寸不烂之舌破局

dialogue.content: 'A mere ant dares to speak with me?' A cold voice rang out from the dimensional rift, the will of the Eye of Heaven pressing down like something tangible. Yet Chen Ji showed no fear, instead stepping forward and declaring: 'There must be a reason for dimensional invasion of the Three Realms. If you simply wanted to destroy the world, why bother with all this?' His words, empowered by spiritual energy, echoed through the nine heavens, even causing the Guardian army to falter.

text.content: After a moment of silence, the voice spoke again, but with an added tone of amusement: 'Interesting... the Tianji Record's wielder... you are more bold than any prophet before.' In the void, a massive eye slowly formed, its pupil seemingly containing the mysteries of an entire dimension, 'Since that's the case, I shall give you a chance—surrender the Tianji Record, and I shall spare these Three Realms insects.'

choices.description: Preserve strength while fighting and retreating, lead the battlefield toward more favorable terrain, trade space for time and intelligence advantage
choices.visible_reward: Reduce casualties and gain breathing room for a more meticulous plan.
choices.risk_hint: May be pursued, falling into an even more dangerous predicament.

dialogue.content: "Withdrawal?" Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji in disbelief, "You know what this will mean! The Three Realms Allied Forces will think we are afraid!" Yet Chen Ji simply glanced at her indifferently. The depth in that gaze made her instantly understand something—this man has never made a pointless retreat.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was only for her to hear: "Sister Su, may I borrow your sword." Before the words finished, he had already taken Su Qingyao's sword, slicing through the void and creating a ten-thousand-zhang chasm between the Three Realms Allied Forces and the Guardian. "This is a natural barrier—if the Guardian wants to pursue, let them taste the weight of the Three Realms' mountains and rivers!" His voice resounded across the battlefield, and the originally low morale strangely began to rise.

Yet Ling Yuan's fangs came far faster than imagined. The moment Chen Ji was distracted dealing with the Guardian, a fierce sword light stabbed from behind him—a strike capable of destroying heaven and earth, with Ling Yuan channeling centuries of accumulated resentment. "Chen Ji! The Tianji Record is mine!" The old sect master's roar shattered the void, endless blood energy pouring from his body. He was actually surrounded by power of the same source as the Guardian—he had long since merged with the dimensional forces!

"Brother!" Su Qingyao's cry cut through the air. Her reaction was lightning-fast, her form darting towards Chen Ji. However, Ling Yuan had anticipated this, directing another blade of light towards Su Qingyao, intending to erase her as well. "No!" Chen Ji's pupils constricted. The Tianji Record疯狂翻动 in his hand, countless threads of causality intertwining into a net—he saw an image, Su Qingyao bloodstained on the battlefield. This scene must never happen!

dialogue.content: "Don't worry about me!" Su Qingyao's voice carried a hoarse resolve, yet her body不听使唤地 continued forward. "You fool of a Chen Ji! Why must you always..." Before she could finish, Ling Yuan's sword light was already within reach. Her eyes finally moistened—she realized, without knowing when, she could no longer watch him die alone.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's lethal strike is imminent, Su Qingyao's life hangs by a thread, the Tianji Record's prophecy is about to come true—you must make a choice at this moment.

choices.description: Use your body as a shield, taking Ling Yuan's lethal strike to ensure Su Qingyao's safety.
choices.visible_cost: Severely injured, Heavenly Fate Value greatly depleted.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's affection has broken through the critical threshold, unlocking the "Shared Fate" buff.
choices.risk_hint: Difficult to handle subsequent battle in severely injured state.

text.content: The sound of sword light piercing flesh was crystal clear. Chen Ji took Ling Yuan's lethal strike on his back, blood erupting and staining half his body. Yet his first reaction was not to check his own wound, but to violently turn his head, staring intently at Su Qingyao—"Are you alright?" These three words were as light as a sigh, yet so heavy that Su Qingyao's tears burst forth.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... you..." Su Qingyao's voice choked, her trembling hand pressing against his back wound, spiritual energy flooding in. "You bastard! Why... why must you always do this!" Her tears fell onto his shoulder, yet her voice grew increasingly firm. "From now on, your wounds are my wounds."

text.content: At this very moment, a strange light bloomed from Su Qingyao's brow, resonating with the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's body. "Shared Fate"—this buff never before triggered, silently activated between life and death. Su Qingyao felt an unprecedented connection. She could sense Chen Ji's every heartbeat, every trace of Heavenly Fate Value draining. From this moment on, their fates became thoroughly intertwined.

choices.description: Without dodging or evading, channel the Tianji Record's power to propel a causal sword, slaying Ling Yuan before being struck.
choices.visible_cost: May not be able to fully protect Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_reward: Kill Ling Yuan on the spot, completely eliminating the internal threat.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may be affected by the backlash.

text.content: "Ling Yuan, did you think I didn't know about your collusion with the Guardian?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold and biting. The Tianji Record bloomed with brilliant golden light in his hand, countless threads of causality pouring from the book, weaving into a net of destiny. "From the moment you stepped into the coordinates, your death was already sealed." Before the words finished, a causal sword shot from his fingertip, heading directly for Ling Yuan's brow!

dialogue.content: "Impossible! You clearly already..." Ling Yuan's eyes widened. He felt the breath of death, yet it was too late to dodge. "You entered the chess game long ago, yet still thought yourself the chess player." Chen Ji's voice remained unruffled. The causal sword pierced through his brow. "Pitiful." Ling Yuan's body slowly dissolved in mid-air, his eyes filled with unwillingness and terror—he had schemed his entire life, yet ultimately became a discarded piece on someone else's chessboard.

text.content: Yet the moment Ling Yuan dissolved, another sword light still struck towards Su Qingyao. Chen Ji's pupils constricted, yet there was no time to defend—"No!" His scream resounded across the battlefield.

choices.description: Using softness to overcome hardness, borrowing Ling Yuan's sword momentum to guide the direction, dissolving the attack while safely evacuating with Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_cost: Missed the opportunity to kill Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, safely relocate with Su Qingyao.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will pursue more frantically.
choices.process_label: 你以巧劲化解了致命一击

text.content: Chen Ji's movement technique was fully displayed at this moment. His left hand embraced Su Qingyao's waist, his right hand drew a circle, using Ling Yuan's sword momentum as guidance, redirecting that world-destroying strike toward the sky. "Borrow force to counter force, four ounces to move a thousand pounds—Ling Yuan, your sword is too straight." His voice carried a hint of mockery, yet his body had already carried Su Qingyao back ten zhang away in an instant.

dialogue.content: "Despicable!" Ling Yuan's face turned ashen with fury. He discovered that his proud killing blow had been so easily deflected. "Chen Ji! Do you only know how to flee!" Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, that contemptuous grin more cutting than any words—"Ling Yuan, senior, after living for several hundred years, do you still lack such composure? No wonder the Tianji Record did not choose you."

text.content: This sentence completely shattered Ling Yuan's Dao heart. The old sect master's body trembled with rage, his eyes nearly spitting fire—the Tianji Record not choosing him was the greatest obsession of his hundreds of years, the root cause of his fall.

Ling Yuan's fall seemed to enrage the Eye of Heavenly Mandate. The dimensional rift expanded violently, and a giant eye formed entirely from pure dimensional power appeared above the heavens. Within its pupil seemed to reside the will of the entire universe. "Ant, you dare to kill this one's earthly chess piece." That voice no longer carried the previous playfulness, but genuine killing intent. "Since it is so, this Three Realms... have no need to exist." Countless guardians surged down like a tide. They no longer held back, unleashing full combat power. The Three Realms Allied Army's formation instantly shattered.

"Chen Ji!" Ye Qing's voice rang from the distance. The demonic mist around her had reached extreme intensity. "I'll buy you time—use the Demonic Path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura—now, fuse the final fragment!" She didn't wait for a response, directly transforming into a beam of black light and charging into the guardian army. "Demonic Path Mist—All Beings Shall Be Lost!" Black fog swept the battlefield like a tsunami, and the guardians' attacks grew chaotic, beginning to slaughter each other.

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record agitating more intensely than ever before. That final fragment lay at the deepest part of the dimensional rift, calling to him, urging him. Yet he also understood that once he fused the complete Tianji Record, the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's attention would lock onto him entirely. "Chen Ji." An ancient voice spoke in his mind—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "When the Tianji Record is complete, that is the day fate strikes back. Have you thought this through?" Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then wore a relieved smile: "I never lived to escape fate."

dialogue.content: "Excellent, excellent." A hint of appreciation even appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's voice. "None of the Tianji Record's past holders were anything but tragedies consumed by fate. Only you dare face this one directly." That enormous eye suddenly shot out a beam of light, straight toward Chen Ji. "Since it is so, this one shall give you a chance—the winner takes all, the loser becomes the villain. Come, let this one see—what right do you, the final Prophet, possess to bear the Tianji Record!"

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Mandate's will descends directly—this is the ultimate confrontation transcending all mortal power. How will you face this judgment of fate?

choices.text: Fuse the fragment and face it head-on.
choices.description: Immediately fuse the final fragment, using the complete Tianji Record's power to directly confront the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.
choices.visible_cost: Fate's backlash will arrive earlier, the body bearing ultimate overload.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record's full capabilities, gaining the power to confront the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.
choices.risk_hint: The backlash may cause permanent damage.
choices.process_label: 你选择与命运正面对决

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_融合残页正面硬抗_001
text.content: Chen Ji no longer hesitated. He stepped forward, his form flickering like lightning toward the dimensional rift. The Tianji Record in his hand turned itself to the final pages. That last fragment floated at the rift's deepest point, emanating ancient and mysterious light. He reached out and touched that fragment—at that instant, heaven and earth lost color, sun and moon were extinguished. The complete Tianji Record awakened thoroughly at this moment, and countless threads of causality wove before his eyes into a giant net covering the Three Realms.

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_融合残页正面硬抗_002
text.content: "So this is... complete causality?" Chen Ji murmured to himself. He saw the convergence point of all causality—past, present, and future. However, at the same time, a terrifying backlash force began corroding his body. Every cell screamed, every meridian burned. "Excellent, excellent!" The Eye of Heavenly Mandate's voice carried frenzied battle intent. "Finally, an opponent worthy of this one's serious attention!"

choices.text: Stall for time to find weaknesses.
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to seek the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's weaknesses during combat before making a decision.
choices.visible_cost: The longer the time, the heavier the Allied Army casualties.
choices.visible_reward: May discover the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's fatal weakness.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Mandate may launch a lethal strike at any moment.

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_拖延时间寻找破绽_001
text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record's power flowing around him, beginning to deduce every possible weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate. "You are clever." The Eye of Heavenly Mandate seemed to see through his intent. "But this one has existed for hundreds of millions of years, never once having a weakness." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a cold smile curling his lips: "No weakness? Then it can only mean your eyes are not numerous enough." His words contained hidden meaning. The Tianji Record was frantically calculating a possibility—the dimensional guardians were not invincible; they had a fatal weakness.

dialogue.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_拖延时间寻找破绽_002
dialogue.content: "Found it." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a rare surge of excitement. "The Guardian's power stems from the dimensional rift, and the core maintaining that rift lies deep within the pupil of the Heaven's Eye. That is the only existence not belonging to this dimension, and their only weakness." Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze piercing through layers of void to stare directly at that colossal celestial eye. "So that's it... Heaven's Eye, you too have something to fear."

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_拖延时间寻找破绽_003
text.content: The Heaven's Eye seemed to sense something, a subtle fluctuation flickering across its pupil. "You dare spy on this one's secrets?" The voice turned dangerous. "Insignificant creature, you have overstepped!" A destructive beam shot from the pupil, aiming straight for Chen Ji's Brow Center—yet Chen Ji smiled, for he had finally glimpsed the possibility of victory.

choices.text: Unite everyone for a combined strike
choices.description: Call upon Su Qingyao, Ye Qing and all allies, gathering everyone's power into one point for a final assault
choices.visible_cost: Time is needed for assembly, and the enemy may seize the opportunity to counterattack
choices.visible_reward: When many add wood to the fire, the flames burn higher—the combined power is enough to shake the Heaven's Eye
choices.risk_hint: If coordination fails, the entire army may be annihilated
choices.process_label: 你选择相信同伴的力量

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_联合众人合力一击_001
text.content: "Su Qingyao! Ye Qing!" Chen Ji's voice resounded across the battlefield. "Lend me your power!" Two figures shot toward him almost simultaneously—Su Qingyao's sword intent like ice sealing ten thousand miles, Ye Qing's demonic mist like the darkness of the deepest night. Chen Ji raised the Tianji Record high above his head, three forces merging within him to weave an unprecedented sword of karma. "This sword, for all beings of the Three Realms!" The combined cry of three people shook the heavens, and that sword light carrying power enough to tear the sky slashed straight toward the Heaven's Eye!

dialogue.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_联合众人合力一击_002
dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, this time we fight side by side!" Su Qingyao's voice was firm yet gentle as her hand overlapped with Chen Ji's, their spiritual meridians connected. "Hmph, you臭男人, remember you owe me a favor." Ye Qing's words were relentless, yet her demonic mist merged without hesitation into that torrent of power. At this moment, the three's forces intertwined perfectly, and fate was forever rewritten.

text.id: 天机录_ch1121_result_联合众人合力一击_003
text.content: The sword light pierced through the void, and the Guardians retreated in haste. Even the Heaven's Eye slightly narrowed its gaze. "Interesting..." For the first time, a note of gravity appeared in the voice. "But not enough!" The instant the two forces collided, heaven and earth collapsed. Countless stars were reduced to powder in that single strike. The Three Realms Allied Forces and the Guardian Army were both blasted backward by that power, the battlefield torn into chaos.

The battle entered its white-hot phase. The power of the complete Tianji Record surged violently within Chen Ji, each breath like thunder. Yet the Heaven's Eye's power was equally fathomless, that colossal celestial pupil continuously projecting destructive light that turned the battlefield into scorched earth. "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's cry came from the distance—she was already wounded but still gritted her teeth to persist. Ye Qing's demonic mist was also gradually dissipating, her power near its limit. Both were buying time for him, and he... must, at this moment, make the final choice.

Chen Ji felt intense pain radiating from his chest—the Tianji Record's backlash had begun. His vision blurred, every cell in his body screaming. Yet at this moment, he sensed an unprecedented connection—that was Su Qingyao's "Shared Fate" power, sharing his pain. "You fool..." he whispered in his heart, yet a smile curved his lips. "You said my wounds would be your wounds, and you really took half of them." He didn't know if Su Qingyao could perceive these words, but he knew she would definitely feel his heart.

"Enough!" The Heaven's Eye finally lost patience. Unprecedented light gathered in that massive pupil—the power of dimensional origin, enough to destroy the entire Three Realms in a single strike! "Insignificant creatures, witness this one's fury!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He knew he had to block this strike. For the Three Realms, for Su Qingyao, for Ye Qing, for everyone who believed in him—he must give everything!

"Come!" Chen Ji roared, pushing the Tianji Record's power to its extreme while drawing upon the threads of karma to weave a shield of destiny before him. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's power flooded into his body simultaneously, the three's wills merging completely at this moment. The destructive light crashed into the shield of destiny, time and space seemingly freezing in that instant—then, everything fell silent. When the smoke cleared, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, a shocking wound pierced through his chest, blood staining every inch of ground beneath his feet. Yet the Tianji Record in his arms finally radiated complete and brilliant light.

"You... actually blocked it?" For the first time, a tremor appeared in the Heaven's Eye's voice, that massive pupil staring fixedly at Chen Ji. "Impossible... how could a mortal body possibly..." Chen Ji勉强抬起头，鲜血从嘴角流下，却露出一个嘲讽的笑容："You calculated everything, yet missed one thing." His voice, though weak, was utterly firm. "Heaven's Eye, you never cared about mortal will—and that is precisely my greatest advantage." Before the words even finished, countless threads of karma poured from the Tianji Record, beginning to frantically repair the torn dimensional rift. The Heaven's Eye let out a roar, its massive form beginning to disintegrate—it was being backlash by the karma force, forced to retreat into the depths of dimensions.
